rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is done nicely or satisfactorily.

example.english: If you nicely organize everything, it will not get messy.
example.traditional: 你將啲嘢好好咁整理好，咪唔會亂晒。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 di1 je5 hou2 hou2 gam3 zing2 lei5 hou2 mai5 m4 wui5 lyun6 saai3

rows.jyutping: syu1 syu1 fuk6 fuk6 gam3 V
rows.note: Use this specifically when nicely means pleasantly or comfortably.

example.english: We relaxed nicely by the seaside all afternoon.
example.traditional: 我哋喺海邊舒舒服服咁坐咗成個下午。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hoi2 bin1 syu1 syu1 fuk6 fuk6 gam3 co5 zo2 seng4 go3 haa6 ng5

rows.note: Use this when the result is precisely right or adjusted with good judgment.

example.english: You adjusted the volume nicely; it is not too loud, and everything is clear.
example.traditional: 你將個音量校得啱啱好，唔嘈又聽得清楚。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 go3 jam1 loeng6 gaau3 dak1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 m4 cou4 jau6 teng1 dak1 cing1 co2
